blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, a fundamental question remains: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability? In this work, we reveal that direct failure does not necessarily imply inability. Some reasoning failures can be recovered by exploring the model's own trajectories, exposing a recoverable capability frontier: a policy-dependent region where solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through trajectory-level search. Based on this observation, we introduce ReSI-Math, a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and converts recovered capabilities into data-efficient RLVR supervision. ReSI-Math uses Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search to identify recoverable failures under a fixed policy and adaptively selects frontier problems for sequential RLVR as the policy evolves. On Qwen3-VL-8B, correct-incorrect trajectory crossover produces 272 verifier-confirmed correct offspring from 621 attempts (43.8%). After three sequential one-shot RLVR stages, the MATH500 and WE-MATH average improves from 78.71 to 80.16. Under matched single-problem RLVR, random selection reaches only 53.31 versus 54.16 for frontier-guided Q1.
blocks.zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为改进大语言模型的数学推理的有效方法. 然而,一个根本问题仍然存在:当一个模式未能解决问题时,它是否真的缺乏根本能力? 在这项工作中,我们揭示,直接失败并不一定意味着不能。 一些推理失败可以通过探索模型本身的轨迹来恢复,暴露出一个可回收的能力前沿:一个依赖政策的区域,通过直接解码无法可靠地生成解决方案,但可以通过轨迹级搜索获得解决方案. 基于这一观察,我们引入了ReSI-Math,这是一个探索可回收能力前沿并将回收能力转化为数据高效的RLVR监督的框架. ReSI-Math采用自律师指导的进化搜索,以识别固定政策下可收回的失败,并随政策的发展而适应性地选择前沿问题,用于顺序的RLVR. 在Qune3-VL-8B上,正确不正确的轨迹交叉产生来自621次尝试(43.8%)的272个验证器确认正确的后代. 经过三个相继的一发RLVR级,MATH500和WE-MATH的平均值从78.71提高到80.16. 在匹配的单问题RLVR下,随机选择只达到53.31,而边框制导的Q1则达到54.16.

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach to improving mathematical reasoning in large language models, using verifiable outcomes to optimize reasoning policies Shao et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) . Despite these advances, interpreting a model’s failures remains important for understanding and improving its reasoning. An incorrect response leaves open whether the model cannot produce a valid solution or whether the particular generation process failed to elicit one. This raises a fundamental question: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability?
blocks.zh: 以可核查的奖励强化学习(RLVR)已成为改进大语言模型中数学推理的有效方法,利用可核查的结果来优化推理政策 Shao等 (2024).; Guo等 (2025). 尽管取得了这些进展,解释一个模型的失败对于理解和改进它的推理仍然很重要。 错误的响应会让模型无法产生一个有效的解决方案,或者特定的生成过程未能产生一个. 这提出了一个根本性的问题:当一个模型不能解决问题时,它真的缺乏根本的能力吗?

blocks.en: Evidence from inference-time reasoning suggests that a model’s observed performance depends on how its reasoning is elicited. Repeated sampling and self-refinement can produce successful solutions after unsuccessful attempts Cobbe et al. (2021) ; Madaan et al. (2023) , while CoTEvol shows how reasoning trajectories can be evolved through crossover and mutation Wang et al. (2026) . These findings motivate examining recoverability under fixed model parameters: whether structured exploration of the current model’s own trajectories can produce a verifier-confirmed solution when direct generation remains unreliable. This perspective makes the conditions under which reasoning succeeds part of the object of study.
blocks.zh: 从推断时间推理得到的证据表明,模型观察到的性能取决于其推理方式。 重复采样和自精在尝试失败后可产生成功的解决方案Cobbe等人(2021年);Madaan等人(2023年),而CoTEvol展示了推理轨迹如何通过交叉和突变而演化出王等(2026年). 这些结论促使在固定模型参数下审查可回收性:当直接生成仍然不可靠时,对当前模型自身轨迹的有条不紊地探索能否产生经核实的、经确认的解决方案。 这种观点使得推理成功的条件成为了研究目标的一部分.

blocks.en: We characterize a recoverable capability frontier as a policy-dependent set of problems whose solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through bounded trajectory-level search. Direct sampling describes how consistently a problem is solved, while search probes whether a correct solution can be obtained by examining and recombining generated trajectories. Throughout this exploration, the model parameters remain fixed and an external verifier checks the resulting answers. The frontier is thus defined operationally with respect to the current policy and a specified search procedure and budget.
blocks.zh: 我们把可收回能力前沿视为一系列依赖政策的问题,这些问题的解决办法不是通过直接解码可靠地产生,而是可以通过有限度的轨迹级搜索得到。 直接采样描述一个问题是如何始终如一地得到解决的,而搜索探头则通过对所生成的轨迹进行检查和再组合,能否获得正确的解决方案. 在整个探索过程中,模型参数保持不变,由外部核查员检查结果。 因此,根据现行政策和具体的搜索程序和预算,在业务上界定了边界。

blocks.en: Recoverability also provides a possible connection between capability exploration and subsequent learning. A problem whose solution can be elicited through search, but is not yet reliably generated directly, may offer a useful target for policy optimization. This possibility is particularly relevant to data-efficient RLVR. LIMR Li et al. (2025) demonstrates the value of carefully selected training subsets, and One-Shot RLVR Wang et al. (2025) shows that even a single problem can support substantial reasoning improvements. These results motivate investigating whether search-confirmed recoverability can help identify problems from which the current policy can learn effectively.
blocks.zh: 可回收性还提供了能力探索和随后学习之间的可能联系。 可以通过搜索找到解决办法但尚不能直接可靠地产生的问题,可以为政策优化提供有用的目标。 这种可能性与具有数据效率的低活性脂病毒特别相关。 LIMR Li等(2025年)展现了精心选取的训练子集的价值,One-Shot RLVR Wang等(2025年)显示,即使是一个单一的问题也能支持实质性的推理改进. 这些结果促使人们调查经确认的搜索可恢复性是否能够帮助查明现行政策能够有效学习的问题。

blocks.en: Based on this perspective, we introduce ReSI-Math , a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and uses the resulting signals for reasoning improvement. Under a fixed policy, the model first samples multiple reasoning trajectories and then acts as a Self-Judge to analyze their useful components, potential errors, and complementary information. Evolutionary crossover generates new trajectories from these candidates, and a rule-based verifier determines whether the resulting answers are correct. Problems exhibiting successful recovery become candidates for Solver-RLVR, which optimizes fresh rollouts on the original questions using verifiable outcome rewards. The same exploration also produces verifier-labeled trajectories and exposes self-evaluation errors, providing supervision for separately trained Judge-RLVR.
blocks.zh: 基于这一视角,我们引入了ReSI-Math,这是一个探索可回收能力前沿并利用由此产生的信号改进推理的框架。 在固定政策下,模型首先取出多个推理轨迹的样本,再起自评作用,分析其有用的组件,潜在的出错,以及补充信息. 演化交叉会从这些考生中产生出出新的轨迹,一个基于规则的验证者会决定所得出的答案是否正确. 成功恢复的问题成为Solver-RLVR的候选问题,后者利用可核查的结果奖励,优化了最初问题的新推出。 同样的探索还产生了经核查标记的轨迹并暴露出自我评价错误,为受过单独培训的法官-RLVR提供监督.

blocks.en: The learning process must also account for changes in the policy. Figure 1 shows how observed rollout profiles change across training stages over 28 candidate problems, each evaluated with 16 rollouts. From the base policy to the third stage, the number of all-fail problems decreases from 18 to 12, while the number of all-pass problems increases from 0 to 4; total correct rollouts rise from 37/448 to 128/448. These changes motivate reassessing candidate problems under the updated policy. Building on this motivation, we propose policy-adaptive sequential one-shot RLVR . After each training stage, ReSI-Math reprofiles the updated policy and selects the next frontier problem, yielding a local recursive self-improvement loop.
blocks.zh: 学习过程也必须考虑到政策的变化。 图1显示在整个培训阶段观察到的推出概况的变化,涉及28个候选人问题,每个问题都经过16个推出评价。 从基础政策到第三阶段,全故障数从18个减少到12个,而全故障数从0个增加到4个;正确的推出总数从37/448个增加到128/448个。 这些变化促使根据最新政策重新评估候选人的问题。 基于这一动机,我们提出政策适应性连续一发的RLVR。 在每个训练阶段后,ReSI-Math重新描绘了更新后的政策,并选择了下一个前沿问题,产生了一个局部递归自改进循环.

blocks.en: We evaluate ReSI-Math using Qwen3-VL backbones with 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters. On Qwen3-VL-8B, crossover between a correct and an incorrect trajectory produces 272 verifier-confirmed correct offspring from 621 attempts (43.8%). Three sequential one-shot RLVR stages improve mean accuracy on MATH500 and WE-MATH from 78.71 to 80.16. In a separate single-problem comparison with matched training budgets, frontier-guided selection achieves an average of 54.16 across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, compared with 53.31 for a random-selection baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们使用有2B,4B,8B参数的Quen3-VL骨干来评价ReSI-Math. 在Qune3-VL-8B上,正轨和不正确轨迹之间的交叉产生来自621次尝试(43.8%)的272个被验证者确认的正确子孙. 三相相接一发RLVR相使MATH500和WE-MATH的平均精度从78.71提高到80.16. 在与相应的培训预算进行单独单一问题比较时,前沿指导选择在四个数学推理基准中平均达到54.16个,而随机选择基准为53.31个。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce an operational characterization of recoverable capability frontiers, connecting unreliable direct generation with verifier-confirmed recovery through bounded search under fixed model parameters. • We develop ReSI-Math, a Self-Judge-guided evolutionary framework that identifies candidate problems for Solver-RLVR and produces trajectory-level supervision for Judge-RLVR. • We propose policy-adaptive sequential one-shot RLVR and evaluate frontier-guided learning across three model scales, with analyses of search outcomes, training schedules, and changes in problem solvability.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent studies on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) increasingly suggest that mathematical reasoning can improve with surprisingly limited training data. LIMR ( Li et al., 2025 ) studies data selection for RL scaling and shows that carefully selected subsets can retain strong performance with substantially fewer training examples. One-Shot RLVR ( Wang et al., 2025 ) pushes this regime to the extreme, demonstrating that a single training example can sometimes induce substantial reasoning gains, while DoPR ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) dynamically selects informative examples for policy refinement. Related evidence also appears beyond RLVR: One-Shot OPD ( Fu et al., 2026 ) shows that a single query can recover a large fraction of full-data on-policy distillation gains. More broadly, data-efficient instruction tuning has shown that carefully selected subsets can outperform or approach much larger training sets ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Ivison et al., 2025 ) , and the ordering of training examples can itself affect generalization ( He et al., 2025 ) . These results motivate studying not only how much data is required, but also which examples are most valuable. Our work further treats this value as policy-dependent: the most informative problem may change as the policy itself evolves.
blocks.zh: 最近关于有可核查奖励的强化学习的研究越来越表明,数学推理可以因培训数据惊人地有限而改进。 LIMR(Li等,2025年)为RL缩放研究数据选择,并显示精心选择的子集可以保留强效,培训实例要少得多. One-Shot RLVR(Wang等,2025年)将这个制度推向了极端,表明一个单一的训练例子有时可以带来实质性的推理收益,而DoPR(Zhang等,2026年)则动态地选择了信息化的例子来完善政策. 相关证据也出现在RLVR之外: One-Shot OPD(Fu等,2026年)显示,一个单一的查询可以取回政策分馏收益的一大部分完整数据. 更广泛地说,数据效率高的指令调试表明,经过仔细挑选的子集可以超越或接近更大的培训集(Chen等,2024;Xia等,2024;Ivison等,2025),培训实例的排序本身可以影响归纳(He等,2025)。 这些结果不仅促使人们研究需要多少数据,而且还促使人们研究哪些例子最有价值。 我们的工作进一步将这一价值视为政策依赖性:信息最丰富的问题可能会随着政策本身的发展而改变。

blocks.en: Another line of work improves reasoning through repeated sampling, self-refinement, or evolutionary search. Best-of-N Cobbe et al. (2021) and Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) obtain better solutions through sampling or iterative feedback, while COTEVOL ( Wang et al., 2026 ) formulates CoT synthesis as population-based evolutionary search. In contrast, we use evolution as a capability-probing mechanism : rather than focusing only on the final improved CoT, we study whether failed reasoning can be recovered under a fixed policy through trajectory recombination.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作通过反复采样,自修,或进化搜索来改进推理. Best-Of-N Cobbe等 (2021)和自失能(Madaan等,2023)通过采样或迭代反馈获得更好的解决方案,而COTEVOL(Wang等,2026)则将COT合成作为以人口为基础的进化搜索. 相反,我们把进化作为一种能力测试机制 : 而不是只关注最终改进的 CoT, 我们研究失败的推理是否可以通过轨迹重组 在一个固定的政策下恢复。

blocks.en: Prior work has explored using model-generated feedback to improve subsequent reasoning or generation, such as Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Related LLM-as-a-Judge methods use language models to evaluate model-generated responses ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . More recent self-evolving systems further organize such feedback into iterative improvement loops; for example, R-Zero ( Huang et al., 2026 ) improves Challenger and Solver roles through repeated interaction. ReSI-Math instead realizes a local, policy-adaptive recursion in which Self-Judge guides trajectory search, RLVR updates the policy, and the updated policy is reprofiled to determine the next learning target.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作探索了利用模型产生的反馈来改进后继推理或生成,如自指(Madaan等,2023.). 相关的LLM-as-a-judge方法使用语言模型来评价模型生成的响应(郑等,2023.). 更近期的自演系统进一步将此类反馈组织入迭代改进回路;例如,R-Zero(Huang等,2026年)通过反复互动来改进挑战者与溶解者的角色. blocks.en:
In this section, we introduce ReSI-Math , a framework designed to explore Re cursive S elf- I mprovement on Math reasoning problems.
The core idea of ReSI-Math is that a model’s capability boundary need not be observed only after parameter updates through downstream evaluation; instead, it can be actively probed under a fixed policy by conducting structured search over the model’s own reasoning trajectories. As illustrated in Figure 2 , ReSI-Math decomposes the resulting self-improvement procedure into four stages: Elicit , Repair , Consolidate , and Reprofile .

blocks.en: Given candidate regions near the recoverable capability frontier, Repair evaluates whether failed reasoning can be transformed into verifier-confirmed correct solutions through Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search. blocks.en: Self-Judge provides structured analysis of candidate trajectories for evolutionary search. Two complementary judgment modes are considered: the Blind Judge evaluates reasoning without access to verifier outcomes or reference answers, whereas the Guided Judge additionally receives verifier-confirmed outcome feedback while remaining isolated from the reference solution. Self-Judge and the verifier therefore serve distinct functions: Self-Judge provides search guidance, whereas the verifier supplies the external correctness criterion used to determine whether repair succeeds.

blocks.en: For the Solver, a problem that exhibits a verifier-confirmed failure-to-success transition is treated as a recoverable training example. Rather than imitating the evolved correct trajectory itself, Solver-RLVR trains the current policy directly on the original problem using verifier-based rewards. The objective is to transform capability that can only be elicited through search into behavior that can be expressed more reliably through direct generation.
blocks.zh: 对Solver来说,一个显示经核查者确认的失败到成功过渡的问题被视作一个可收回的培训实例。 Solver-RLVR没有模仿进化的正确轨迹本身,而是利用基于核查者的奖励,直接就最初的问题对现行政策进行训练. 目标是将只有通过搜索才能被引出的能力转变为能够通过直接生成更可靠地表达的行为.

blocks.en: Evolution also exposes self-evaluation errors by comparing Self-Judge predictions with verifier-confirmed outcomes. These disagreements provide trajectory-level supervision for Judge-RLVR, where the model is trained to better discriminate whether a candidate reasoning trajectory reaches a correct outcome.
blocks.zh: 进化过程还将自评员的预测与核实者确认的结果进行比较,从而暴露出自我评价错误. 这些分歧为RLVR法官提供了轨迹一级的监督,该模型经过培训,可以更好地区分候选人推理轨迹是否得出正确结果。

blocks.en: The two learning signals are therefore complementary: recoverable problems provide supervision for Solver-RLVR, while judgment errors provide trajectory-level supervision for Judge-RLVR.
blocks.zh: 因此,这两个学习信号是相辅相成的:可收回的问题为Solver-RLVR提供监督,而判断错误为Judge-RLVR提供轨迹级监督.

blocks.en: Thus, Consolidate converts search-time behavior into parameterized capability: recoverable reasoning becomes more stable direct problem-solving behavior, while self-evaluation errors become supervision for more reliable judgment.
blocks.zh: 因此,整合将搜索-时间行为转换为参数化能力:可回收推理会更稳定地直接解决问题行为,而自我评价错误则会成为更可靠的判断的监督.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the primary backbone throughout our experiments, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct.
Qwen3-VL is an open-weight vision-language model family with strong text understanding, visual perception, and multimodal reasoning capabilities.

We construct our evolutionary training pool from MathBook-Pro in WE-MATH 2.0 ( Qiao et al., 2026 ) .
We construct the training data for both Solver-RLVR and Judge-RLVR from a common source of 243 seed mathematical problems. For Solver-RLVR, the evolutionary search produces a 28-problem candidate pool, from which one problem is selected at each sequential stage for single-problem RLVR.
For Judge-RLVR, trajectory-level supervision is derived from the same evolutionary source using verifier-labeled solver trajectories.
Detailed data construction, filtering criteria, and statistics are provided in Appendix A . For Solver checkpoint selection, we construct DEV192 by sampling 96 problems from MATH500 and 96 problems from WE-MATH testmini. Since DEV192 is contained in the full evaluation benchmarks reported in the main tables, we additionally evaluate on subsets that exclude these development examples. The corresponding results are reported in Appendix C .

Full-Batch GRPO is evaluated under the same rollout budget as the policy-adaptive setting, while Fixed-Sequential is included as a lower-budget fixed-order reference; detailed budget accounting is provided in Appendix E.3 .

Under this controlled comparison, policy-adaptive sequential RLVR consistently outperforms Fixed-Seq across all three model scales. Relative to the corresponding Base models, policy-adaptive training improves the average score by 2.15 points on 2B, 0.36 points on 4B, and 1.79 points on 8B, whereas Fixed-Seq decreases the average by 0.23, 1.01, and 1.13 points, respectively.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study

blocks.en: To examine whether the gains from single-problem RLVR can be attributed merely to training on an arbitrary example, we compare our policy-adaptive Q1 selection with a Random-1 baseline under the same 28-problem candidate pool, the same single-problem RLVR setting, and the same training budget. Random-1 improves the overall average only marginally, from 53.23 to 53.31 (+0.08), with inconsistent changes across evaluation dimensions: WE-MATH 1-step increases to 76.87, whereas MATH500 decreases from 85.80 to 85.20 and WE-MATH 3-step drops from 56.36 to 50.30. In contrast, frontier-guided Q1 raises the overall average to 54.16 (+0.93), outperforming Random-1 by 0.85 points, while also exceeding the Base model on MATH500, WE-MATH Overall, 2-step, 3-step, and OlympiadBench. These results indicate that, in the extreme low-data single-problem RLVR regime, the observed gains cannot be explained solely by training on an arbitrary example; under a matched training budget, the alignment between the selected problem and the current policy state materially affects downstream generalization performance.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce ReSI-Math , a framework for recursive self-improvement in mathematical reasoning. Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search probes the recoverable capability frontier and uses crossover to repair failed reasoning into verifier-confirmed correct trajectories. Recoverable problems and judgment–verification discrepancies provide complementary supervision for Solver-RLVR and Judge-RLVR, respectively. Policy-adaptive sequential RLVR re-profiles the problem pool after each policy update to guide subsequent training. Experiments show that evolutionary search uncovers capabilities not yet reliably expressed by the model, while dynamic re-profiling outperforms static schedules in the extreme low-data regime. Thus, ReSI-Math extends evolutionary search beyond data synthesis to capability probing and learning-signal discovery, translating search-time recoverability into more reliable reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReSI-Math, 一个数学推理中递归自我改进的框架. 自行裁判指导的进化搜索探测器可回收能力前沿,并使用交叉来修复失败推理为验证器确认的正确轨迹. 可收回的问题和判决-核查差异分别为Solver-RLVR和Judge-RLVR提供了补充监督。 按政策顺序排列的RLVR在每次政策更新后重新描述问题库,以指导随后的培训. 实验显示,进化搜索发现了模型尚不能可靠地表达的能力,而动态再定位则超越了极低数据体系中的静态时间表. 因此,ReSI-Math将进取搜索从数据合成扩展到能力探测和学习信号发现,将搜索时间可恢复性转化为更可靠的推理.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This work has two main limitations. First, our dynamic capability frontier is an operational, empirically defined notion under the current experimental setting. While sufficient for our analysis, it does not provide a strict characterization of the model’s underlying capability boundary relative to the training data. Second, our experiments focus primarily on the Qwen3-VL family and mathematical reasoning, and we optimize the Solver and Judge separately rather than jointly. Generalization to other model families and reasoning domains, as well as the potential benefits of joint Solver–Judge optimization, remain important directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有两个主要局限。 第一,我们的动态能力前沿是当前试验背景下一个实际的、经验化的概念。 虽然这足以使我们进行分析,但它并没有严格说明模型相对于培训数据的基本能力界限。 其次,我们的实验主要集中于Quen3-VL家族和数学推理,我们分别优化了"Solver"和"Judge"而不是联合优化. 对其他模范家庭和推理领域的概括,以及联合解决方案-法官优化的潜在好处,仍然是未来工作的重要方向。

blocks.en: A.1 Solver-RLVR Data Construction

blocks.en:
The Solver receives a text problem together with its associated image when available; text-only benchmarks contain no image input.
The model generates a reasoning trajectory followed by a final answer formatted as \boxed{...} .
A deterministic rule-based verifier parses the final answer and compares it with the official reference answer.
The verifier supports multiple answer formats, including multiple-choice options, integers, decimals, fractions, radicals, coordinates, and symbolic expressions.
A rollout receives reward 1 if the final answer is verified as correct and 0 otherwise.
blocks.zh:
Solver 在可用时会收到文本问题及其相关图像;仅文本的基准不包含图像输入.
该模型生成一个推理轨迹,然后是最后的答案格式为\boxed{...}.
一个基于规则的决定性核查者对最终答案进行解析并和官方参考答案进行比较.
校验者支持多个答案格式,包括多选择选项,整数,小数,分数,基数,坐标,和符号表达.
如果最后答案被证实正确,则推出获得1分奖励。

blocks.en: A.2 Judge-RLVR Data Construction
blocks.zh: A.2 法官-RLVR 数据构建

blocks.en:
The Judge receives the original problem, the associated image when available, and a candidate Solver trajectory.
Instead of generating a new solution, it predicts whether the candidate reaches a verifier-confirmed correct outcome.
The final judgment is represented as \boxed{1} for correct and \boxed{0} for incorrect.
The underlying verifier label is hidden from the model during RLVR.
The Judge receives reward 1 if its prediction matches the hidden label and 0 otherwise.
Therefore, Judge-RLVR trains outcome discrimination rather than direct answer generation.

它没有产生新的解决办法,而是预测候选人是否达到经核查人确认的正确结果。
最终判决以\boxed{1}表示正确,而\boxed{0}表示不正确。
在RLVR期间,基底的验证器标签被从模型中隐藏出.
如果法官的预测与隐藏的标签相符,则得到1分,否则则得到0分。
因此,RLVR法官培训的是歧视,而不是直接回答。

blocks.en:
We select 243 problems organized into such families as the seed pool for evolutionary search.
This family structure allows us to study complementary reasoning behaviors among closely related multimodal problems and to perform crossover between trajectories that share common semantic structure.

blocks.en:
The resulting evolutionary trajectories provide two types of downstream supervision.
At the problem level , a failure-to-success transition identifies a problem that lies near the model’s recoverable capability frontier and can therefore serve as a candidate for Solver-RLVR.
At the trajectory level , the evolutionary process produces verifier-confirmed correct and incorrect candidate solutions, which can be converted into Judge-RLVR examples.
Thus, the same evolutionary source provides complementary supervision for solving and judging, although the corresponding training units are different: problems for Solver-RLVR and candidate trajectories for Judge-RLVR.

blocks.en: E.2 Checkpoint-wise Rollout Dynamics of Sequential Solver-RLVR
blocks.zh: E.2 序列溶解器-RLVR的检查点驱动动态

blocks.en: The same family model induces substantially different frontier candidate pools across model scales. As shown in Table 1 , the resulting pools contain 69 problems for Qwen3-VL-2B, 32 for 4B, and 28 for 8B. This monotonic decrease with model size suggests that a larger fraction of the shared problem distribution lies near the recoverable capability boundary for smaller models, whereas stronger models move more problems away from this intermediate regime. The corresponding checkpoint-wise profiles in Tables 10 – 12 further show that the behavior of these frontier problems is strongly scale-dependent.
blocks.zh: 同一家庭模式在模型尺度上吸引了相当不同的前沿候选人才。 如表1所示,由此产生的集合包含Qune3-VL-2B的69个问题,4B的32个问题,8B的28个问题。 这种以模型大小为单位的单调下降表明,共享问题分布的更小部分位于较小模型的可回收能力界限附近,而更强的模型使更多的问题脱离了这种中间体系. 表10 – 12中相应的检查站剖面图进一步显示这些前沿问题的行为高度依赖规模.

blocks.en: Checkpoint-wise rollout profiles in Tables 10 – 12 reveal that single-problem RLVR does not induce uniformly monotonic capability improvement. On Qwen3-VL-2B (Table 10 ), Q1 reaches 16/16 early and remains fully retained throughout subsequent Q2 and Q3 stages, while Q3 is progressively consolidated to near-perfect rollout success; this stable retention is consistent with the largest relative benchmark gain observed in Table 1 . In contrast, Qwen3-VL-4B (Table 11 ) exhibits a target-specific degradation regime during Q2 training, where the post-hoc Q2 profile decreases from 10/16 at initialization to 0/16 at later checkpoints despite continued optimization on Q2. Qwen3-VL-8B (Table 12 ) shows an intermediate pattern, with temporary degradation of Q1 during Q2 training followed by partial recovery during Q3 training. These results indicate that frontier training is directionally plastic: a single problem can move the policy either toward or away from reliable expression of a targeted capability.
blocks.zh: 表10-12中的检查点推出剖面图显示,单问题RLVR不能促进统一单调能力改进。 在Qwen3-VL-2B上(表10),Q1提前达到16/16分,并在随后的Q2和Q3阶段保持完全保留,而Q3则被逐渐整合为接近完美推出的成功;这种稳定的保留与表1观察到的最大相对基准增益一致. 相形之下,Qune3-VL-4B(表11)在Q2培训期间显示出一种针对具体目标的退化制度,在Q2培训期间,Hoc Q2之后的特征从初始化时的10/16降至后期检查站的0/16,尽管持续地优化了Q2. Qune3-VL-8B(表12)显示出一种中间模式,在Q2培训期间,Q1暂时退化,而后在Q3培训期间部分恢复. 这些结果表明,边境培训具有可塑性:一个单一的问题可以使政策走向或脱离目标能力的可靠表现。

blocks.en: Table 13 further shows that capability recovery is not necessarily globally beneficial. Starting from the selected Q3@650 policy on Qwen3-VL-8B, re-training Q1 increases its rollout success from 11/16 to 16/16, but simultaneously reduces the previously mastered Q2/Q3-related family from 64/64 to 23/64 and decreases DEV192 from 78.12 to 75.00. The corresponding full-test average also drops from 80.16 to 78.47. Thus, local reacquisition of a target capability can suppress previously consolidated capabilities, providing direct evidence that sequential single-problem RLVR exhibits non-monotonic and bidirectional interference. In more severe cases, this interference manifests as partial or temporary forgetting of previously acquired capabilities.
blocks.zh: 表13还显示,能力恢复不一定有利于全球。 从所选择的Q3@650对Qwen3-VL-8B政策开始,再培训Q1将推出成功率从11/16提高到16/16,但同时将之前掌握的Q2/Q3相关家庭从64/64降至23/64,将DEV192从78.12降至75.00. 相应的全测试平均值也从80.16降至78.47. 因此,当地重新获得目标能力可以压制先前的整合能力,提供直接证据,证明连续的单问题RLVR表现出非摩诺和双向干扰. 在更严重的情况下,这种干涉表现为部分或暂时忘记以前获得的能力。

blocks.en: E.3 Rollout-Budget Control
blocks.zh: E.3 推出预算控制

blocks.en: To separate the effect of training schedule from the amount of sampled supervision, we strictly match the rollout budget between Policy-Adaptive Sequential RLVR and Full-Batch GRPO. For all three model scales, sequential RLVR performs three stages of at most 700 single-problem updates with n = 16 n=16 rollouts per update, yielding 3 × 700 × 16 = 33,600 3\times 700\times 16=33{,}600 rollout responses. Full-Batch GRPO is assigned the same 2,100 prompt slots and therefore the same 33,600 rollout responses. Because the candidate-pool sizes differ across model scales, we use 30 full updates over the 69-problem pool followed by a 30-example partial update for 2B, 65 full updates over the 32-problem pool followed by a 20-example partial update for 4B, and 75 full updates over the 28-problem pool for 8B. The resulting budgets are exactly 33,600 rollouts in all cases. The Fixed-Sequential baseline follows the original 700-step fixed-order protocol with batch size 1 and n = 16 n=16 , corresponding to 11,200 rollouts; we therefore report it as a lower-budget scheduling reference rather than a budget-matched comparator.
blocks.zh: 为了将培训时间表的影响与抽样监督的数量区分开来,我们严格地将政策-调整型序列RLVR和Full-Batch GRPO之间的推出预算相匹配。 对所有三个模型天平,相继的RLVR执行最多700个单问题更新的3个阶段,每次更新的n=16n=16个展开,生成3×700×16=33,600 3\times 700\times 16=33{,}600个展开响应. Full-Batch GRPO被分配到同样的2,100个快档,因此得到相同的33,600个推出响应. 由于候选-池大小因模型尺度不同而异,我们使用69个问题池的30个完整更新,然后对2B进行30个实例的部分更新,对32个问题池的65个完整更新,对4B进行20个实例的部分更新,对8B进行28个问题池的75个完整更新. 由此产生的预算在所有情况下都是33 600个。 固定序号基线采用原700步固定序号协议,批号为1和n=16n=16,相当于11 200推出;因此,我们将其报告为较低预算的列表参考,而不是与预算相匹配的参照。
